title: Directus DevOps Deployment
points: Deployed Directus on AWS EC2 using Docker Compose with a PostgreSQL backend.
Automated CI/CD with GitLab CI and GitHub Actions for validation and health checks.
Configured EC2 security groups, environment variables, and persistent storage for 99% availability.

title: Exam Interface Management System
points: Built a responsive interface for students and instructors using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Implemented AWS Auto Scaling and WAF to handle peak traffic with 99% availability.
Built a scalable platform with EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, and CloudWatch monitoring.
Reduced manual evaluation effort by 60% with auto-grading workflows.

title: Secure File Management System
points: Designed MFA login with role-based access control for secure operations.
Implemented encrypted file handling and activity logging for traceability.
Delivered a responsive UI with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Improved user experience efficiency by 40% through streamlined interaction design.
